card.name: Partway through NSAID drug names
card.fires_on: Positions inside or just after NSAID names such as diflunisal, nabumetone, naproxen and mefenamic acid, where the next piece is expected to continue the name. It also fires on small words like "to" or "and" next to these drugs in label text.

modes.label: Inside NSAID names
modes.description: Middle pieces of NSAID names like diflunisal, nabumetone and naproxen.
modes.example: In a mixed drug overdose, ingestion of 7.5 grams of dif<<l>>unisal resulted in death.

modes.label: Linking words after NSAID
modes.description: Small words such as "to" or "and" right after a drug name or hypersensitivity phrase in NSAID labels.
modes.example: Nabumetone is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity<< to>> nabumetone or its excipients

card.writes: It pushes toward NSAID name pieces like Ib, IL, NSA and prost, as in ibuprofen, NSAID and prostaglandin.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of NSAID drug names, such as naproxen or diflunisal, as the name is being spelled out.
